create_RecordingThreadPool: create a RecordingThreadPool instance with a specified number of max workers
submit_task_to_RecordingThreadPool: submit a callable function with arguments to the RecordingThreadPool for async execution
check_was_used_on_RecordingThreadPool: check if the RecordingThreadPool has been used by calling the was_used method
test_RecordingThreadPool_submit: test the RecordingThreadPool submit method to verify it records usage and delegates to the executor
review_RecordingThreadPool_class: review the RecordingThreadPool class that extends ThreadPoolExecutor to track whether submit was ever called
